subject: Law Enforcement Identification and Masking Ordinance
overview: The committee discussed and approved a proposed ordinance regulating law enforcement masking and identification, forwarding the measure to the regular City Council meeting.

items.title: Resolution 26031: Proposed Law Enforcement Identification and Masking Ordinance
items.summary: The committee approved and voted to send to the regular City Council meeting a proposed ordinance that restricts police face coverings with certain exceptions and mandates the visible display of officer identification.
